answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 54406 Country: Pakistan Title: Nikah and Mahr Question: I have question, if a person whose income is not halal, performs nikah and pays mahr form that income. In this case his nikah would be valid or not. Answer ID: 54406 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1352/916/L=10/1435) Nikah shall be valid. However, he should pay the mahr from halal income. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
